name: @w6w-apps/guru
description: Search, read and manage Guru cards, collections and folders — the AI-powered knowledge base.

w6w.longDescription:
Guru is an AI-powered knowledge management platform organized around Cards (individual pieces of verified knowledge), Collections (top-level knowledge bases, usually one per team) and Folders (Guru's UI calls these "Boards" — the groupings of related Cards within a Collection).

This app covers that core surface headlessly: search Cards by keyword, read a Card's full content and metadata, create and update Cards (including their verification state), and manage Collections and Folders. It also surfaces team membership, useful for looking up a verifier or owner before assigning one.

Guru's Trust Score / verification workflow — Cards are marked TRUSTED, STALE or NEEDS_VERIFICATION and carry a verifier who is responsible for keeping them accurate — is a first-class part of the model here: the verify action and the verification fields on every Card action are not an afterthought bolted on top of a generic CMS shape.

Guru's newer AI Agent / Knowledge Agent / Chat surface (agents, skills, quality runs, MCP configuration) is a separate and much larger subsystem and is deliberately out of scope for this app; see the README.
